# The Signal Run

Mara Vale climbed the relay spire 2 nights after the vault, the tube of drawings strapped across her back.
The city below ran its lights in patterns she had memorized before she could write.
Joss Arden waited at the platform rail, coat collar up against the wind off the plates.
"You opened it," Joss said. It was not a question.
"I read the label 3 times," Mara said. "It is my hand. It is dated 2 years out."
She set the tube on the bench between them and did not touch it again.
The relay hummed through its cycle, and the missing map stayed missing.
Somewhere under the street plates, the Undervault kept its second seal broken and its shelves bare.
Mara watched the grid until the pattern repeated, then said what they both already knew.
"Whoever drew this knew the route we have not taken yet."
